summary: - **[key4hep/k4geo#625](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/625)** — Geometry constructors now set sensitive-detector types directly, and every `<sensitive type="..."/>` entry is removed from the compact XML files. Before this, ddsim could silently assign a type whenever the string contained "tracker" or "calorimeter". `SimpleCylinder_o1_v01` and `SimpleCone_o1_v01` now produce tracker hits and the layered `SimpleCylinder_o1_v02` produces calorimeter hits, so the FCChh tail catcher switches from calorimeter hits to tracker hits. Archived FCCDetectors drivers used by `FCCee_o2_v03` need the same update to load these compacts.

- **[key4hep/CLDConfig#98](https://github.com/key4hep/CLDConfig/pull/98)** — The `CONFIG` dictionary in `CLDReconstruction.py` is replaced by command-line arguments (`--calorimeterIntegrationTimeWindow`, `--overlay`, `--vertexUnconstrained`, `--outputMode`), including `--overlay=Skip` to run without overlay. `--native` combined with `--outputMode LCIO` is now an argument error. `BEAM_SPOT_SIZES` is updated to luminous-region sizes from the 2025 FCC Feasibility Study Report, which changes reconstruction output, so samples should be labelled as produced before or after this change.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#109](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/109)** — Adds an initial ACTS Adaptive Multi-Vertex Finder for primary-vertex reconstruction from existing EDM4hep tracks. It has configurable track selection, beam-spot constraint, seeding, annealing and fit settings, and stores vertex–track associations through `ReconstructedParticle`s and weighted `VertexRecoParticleLink`s. A CLD setup tuned for FCC-ee conditions was validated against LCFIPlus, and a CLD integration test is added.

- **[key4hep/EDM4hep#534](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/534)** — Adds `MutableSimCalorimeterHit::addMCParticleContribution`, which attaches a `CaloHitContribution` and adds its energy to the hit in one call. This avoids hits whose energy does not match their contributions, e.g. when merging hits in `OverlayTiming`. The documentation now states that `SimCalorimeterHit` energy is the sum of its contributions with no time selection, so time windows must be applied in digitization; the schema is unchanged.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#137](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/137)** — `CKFTrackingAlg` now takes each hit's time resolution from the EDM4hep 1.2 tracker-hit time error, for both 4D CKF measurements and seeding time cuts. `HitTimeResolutions` remains a fallback for older files, and a hit with neither now throws.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#74](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/74)** — `DDPlanarDigi` stores the per-layer time resolution used for smearing as the hit `timeError` (EDM4hep ≥ 1.2). Downstream tracking can therefore use per-hit time uncertainties; without time smearing the value stays 0.

- **[key4hep/k4GaudiPandora#51](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora/pull/51)** — `DDPandoraPFANewAlgorithm` gains theta–energy (2D) electromagnetic and hadronic energy corrections, configured as JSON tables via `ElectromagneticThetaEnergyCorrectionFile` and `HadronicThetaEnergyCorrectionFile`. Tables are validated at initialization. With no file given the correction is the identity, so existing configurations are unchanged. k4GaudiPandora now depends on nlohmann json.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#75](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/75)** — Fixes a crash in `GaudiTrkUtils` for trackers with detector ID > 20, such as the ALLEGRO and IDEA silicon wrapper. The code had relied on an old ILC/LCIO assumption about detector IDs.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#410](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/410)** — The ALLEGRO o1_v03 and o2_v01 recipes now pass the ddsim steering file. Without it, gaseous-tracker hits below 1 keV were discarded and hits were merged, which breaks drift-chamber digitization.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1703](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1703)** — Adds a `PlacementPathCache` and uses it when building the SurfaceManager maps. The first surface-map build for ALLEGRO_o1_v04 drops from about 350 s to 1.8 s, removing most of the initialization time of the first `DDPlanarDigi`.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#114](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/114)** — `TracksFromGenParticles` now builds the MC-particle-to-hit mapping in a single pass instead of a nested loop. This makes the algorithm about 80× faster in ALLEGRO ZH digitization and reconstruction.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1706](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1706)** — Fixes volume divisions so that volume and placement extensions are assigned when a volume is divided or placed. The missing extensions caused null-pointer exceptions when traversing the volume hierarchy.
